notes.title: 0.2.1 - Quick Bug Fixing Update
notes.content:
-Fixed some camera issues
-Fixed spawn issues. Some players were able to break boxes and grab weapons begore the match started
-Fixed weapon's reload times
-Added Gamepad' stick menu compatibility

notes.title: 0.2.0 "The Gimmicky Update" Launch
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45675577/e939837e910ad7812d3c31dad14595fde87c91d0.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello Cubes! We are exited to announce our first metagame update! This new version includes four new weapons, some map fixing and quality-of-life improvements. Let's check out what's new![/p][p][/p][h3]New unique weapons![/h3][list][*][p][b]Magic Wand: [/b]Its spells will mirror your enemies' movements, making them feel dizzy and confused.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smoke Grenade Launcher: [/b]Your opponent is quite good at aiming? Let's cover their vision with this brand new grenade launcher![/p][/*][*][p][b]Buttergun: [/b]Proceed with caution! Getting hit with a butter will make your sides very slippery and you might lose control![/p][/*][*][p][b]Bubblegun: [/b]Trap your enemies in bubbles that will lift them up in the sky, making them an easy target for everyone.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45675577/4b3afd0637b23945f69464a20089ff095d58457a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Map Fixing[/h3][p]This section includes all maps that have been modified, test them out to be one step ahead of your foes![/p][list][*][p][b]Hill Map 4[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Desert Map 1[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Air Map 1[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Air Map 3[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Air Map 4[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Towers (Town Map 2)[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Added a brand new [b]How to Play[/b] section, where you can check which buttons and keys control your cubes.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now [b]disable[/b] your [b]controller's vibration.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]General bug fixing.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]
